A recording as a data frame

Source: R/movie_methods.R
as.data.frame.replayr_movie.Rd

Returns one row per observation of one controller: its position in the file, the button states, the numeric channels, the selected stick representations and the commands. Columns are named by the keys of button_layout() and channel_layout(). For an unassigned replayr_poll_stream the result is that of polls().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'replayr_movie'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ..., idx = 1L)

# S3 method for class 'replayr_poll_stream'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A replayr_movie or replayr_poll_stream.

row.names, optional

As in base::as.data.frame(); optional is not used.

...

Not used.

idx

Player index, 1-based.

Value

A data frame. observation is the position of the row in the file, which differs from the row number after a selection with [. A numeric channel whose key is also the key of a button has _value appended to its name.

Examples

movie <- read_movie(system.file("extdata", "sample.dtm", package = "replayr"))
head(as.data.frame(movie))
